result.description:
Expected Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 per year

We are looking for a Full Time Sous Chef, Qualified chefs and casual cooks to join our team in Fremantle. 

Located on the beautiful Swan River, We have established itself in the hospitality scene over the last 4 years as a venue delivering a fun and relaxed drinking and dining experience with a picture perfect view. Inspired by the Mediterranean coastline, We offers a fresh seasonal menu delivered by a motivated kitchen team dedicated to quality food.

Open 5 days a week (Wednesday - Sunday), will be going into a 7 day week trading during summer as well as offering breakfast, serving food throughout the day and into the evening, this sun soaked venue is a great next step for an up and coming Sous Chef.

A little bit about us…
Our team is small but mighty, and we love what we do
We are an organized, well established and progressive hospitality venue
We have a strong focus on people and culture
Our menu is dynamic and regularly changes, keeping things fresh and exciting
We look after each other and we have fun

What we are looking for… 
The right candidate will need to be proactive, be ready to roll up their sleeves,  jump on board and take the lead of our enthusiastic vibrant team as this will be a very hands on role.
A genuine interest in all things food, and passion and care for great produce
The sous chef will support our Head Chef with the recruitment, training, development and mentorship of our team
Experience and understanding of kitchen operations and people management 
Actively promote and enable a healthy positive work culture . 
We are also looking for qualified chefs and cooks to get ready for the busy summer ahead.
Maintain an exceptional standard of hygiene and cleanliness
Must have the right to work in Australia or be a permanent resident 

What can we offer you… 
A Sous Chef role in a small venue like us means you will be across every aspect of the kitchen operation and have the opportunity to liaise and negotiate with suppliers, and collaborate on menu development and contribute to the menu with dish suggestion and creation. 
A competitive salary - this will be offered based on experience
Set days off and balanced roster
Kitchen with a view and dolphins on our doorstep 
Free daily staff meal is provided
Free parking nearby

If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you. 

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following culinary arts qualifications have you obtained?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you have experience training & managing kitchen staff?
How many years of people management experience do you have?
How many years' experience do you have as a qualified chef?

Skills

The successful candidate will possess:
-	Outstanding culinary knowledge and a genuine passion for authentic Indian cuisine.

-	Experience in menu planning, recipe development and food presentation.

Our Story
Founded in 1934, the Tibaldi family of butchers had a dream to provide Australian’s with only the finest cuts of meats processed the traditional way using authentic Italian recipes.
90 years later not much has changed. Today, Tibaldi is a major supplier to the retail, route and food service industry across Australia. The company’s state of the art facilities in Clayton excels industry standards using leading technology.
The product range spans across traditional Italian salami, ham, bacon, traditional smallgoods, fresh meat including a range of Outdoor Bred pork.

•	Conduct environmental monitoring activities, including waste, water, energy, emissions, noise, and biodiversity assessments.

A thriving, well-established medical centre in Carlingford is seeking an enthusiastic General Practitioner to join its dynamic team to meet rapidly growing patient demand. As a highly sought-after practice where the current clinical team is fully booked, the incoming doctor can expect a full patient load from their very first day. Operating as a fully bulk-billed clinic with Bulk Billing Incentives (BBPIP), this practice offers an exceptionally high earning capacity, a competitive 70/30 billings split, and attractive initial financial incentives to ensure a smooth and rewarding transition. 

 The practice environment is designed to optimize patient care while ensuring a collaborative and vibrant workplace. The incoming GP will work alongside a collegiate team of eight to nine doctors each day, supported by a dedicated nursing roster of three nurses most days. The state-of-the-art facilities include a large, main treatment room alongside a separate, dedicated procedure room. Practitioners benefit from a cutting-edge clinical ecosystem utilizing Best Practice software, robust IT infrastructure, HotDoc for seamless patient engagement, and Cubiko for advanced practice analysis. Comprehensive administrative, chronic disease management (CDM), and nursing support are entirely integrated into the daily workflow, allowing doctors to focus single-mindedly on patient outcomes. 

 Ample opportunities exist for professional growth and the pursuit of niche medical passions within the clinic. On-site access to physiotherapy, Douglas Hanly Moir Pathology, and a specialized skin cancer clinic provides a fertile ground for developing special interests. For senior clinicians looking to give back to the profession, the practice highly encourages and supports supervisor opportunities for registrar training. 

 Work-life harmony is central to the clinic’s philosophy, offering highly flexible working arrangements alongside complete clinical autonomy to practice medicine without micromanagement. Continuous Professional Development (CPD) is actively encouraged and supported to ensure ongoing career fulfillment. Located in a vibrant community with easy on-site parking and excellent lifestyle amenities, this position perfectly balances a lucrative, high-volume career with the freedom to enjoy a rewarding life outside of medicine.
